cells.gaps: No evidence row is held on local government revenue records. What is held instead is central: the Rwanda Revenue Authority collects on the districts' behalf, keeping the local government tax register (1,347,846 active taxpayers in June 2024) and the automated LGT system for property tax, with a CAMA valuation model being rolled out. Land, accounts, permit and web systems are also named. Whether any district keeps a revenue record of its own is not established.
cells.note: No row on the sub-indicator, so no rung can be set. A record kept by the national revenue authority is a central system: noted, flagged, and placing nothing.
